q1x-f6 double-spend step-04 does not gro.why: Under the §8.8 door the step's cost does not scale with the disputed transaction's spend-input count: the preimage is hashed once (§7.1) and item n is located by §5.3 arithmetic (§10.5). The band holds the one extra hash over the longer preimage plus the control-subtraction residue, and sits far below the cheapest per-item walk regression measured (+12,129,016 mem / +4,062,287,469 cpu for a half-collection walk).
